# Support Plan Navigators

> Support Plan Navigators Pty Ltd is a local NDIS Support Coordinator and Psychosocial Recovery Coach based in the Orana region of NSW, Australia. We support participants in Dubbo, Wellington, Narromine, Gilgandra, Coonamble, Nyngan, Bourke and surrounding Aboriginal communities, with face-to-face visits and phone or video support.

Tagline: Connecting Plans to Possibilities.

## Services

- [NDIS Support Coordination](https://www.spnavigators.com.au/support-coordination): Level 2 Coordination of Supports. Help to understand an NDIS plan, keep the budget on track, find and connect with providers, set up service agreements, respond when things go wrong, and prepare evidence for plan reassessments. Funded from the Capacity Building – Support Coordination budget of an NDIS plan.
- [Psychosocial Recovery Coaching](https://www.spnavigators.com.au/psychosocial-recovery-coaching): One-on-one, recovery-oriented, trauma-informed coaching for NDIS participants living with psychosocial disability, including a personal recovery plan, everyday skills and links with mental health and community services.

## Who we support

NDIS participants, families and carers, and referrers such as Local Area Coordinators, NDIA planners, GPs, psychologists, hospitals and community organisations. We provide culturally safe support for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander participants and all community members.
